questions.concept: What is the main question posed in the talk?
questions.stem: What is the central question the talk explores?
options: Who owns the control flow?
How to build an AI agent?
What is the best way to code?
Which model is better to use?

questions.concept: What is the role of a harness in an agent system?
questions.stem: What is the role of the harness in an agent system?
options: To run the model's code directly
To provide deterministic code and control the system
To replace the model entirely
To act as a user interface
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model. It is deterministic code, and it is where engineering happens.

questions.concept: What is the purpose of the feedback loop in an agent system?
questions.stem: What is the purpose of the feedback loop in an agent system?
options: To provide the model with more data
To check if the output meets the specification
To speed up the model's processing
To replace the model entirely
questions.source_quote: The feedback loop is around the whole agent. A check compares the output with the specification, and the error goes back in as the next input.

questions.concept: What is the main difference between a loop and a graph in organizing work?
questions.stem: What is the main difference between a loop and a graph in organizing work?
options: Loop is for small tasks, graph is for large tasks
Loop is for known steps, graph is for unknown steps
Loop is for deterministic tasks, graph is for random tasks
Loop is for parallel processing, graph is for sequential processing
questions.source_quote: Loop: one agent inside one feedback loop. You give Claude Code a goal and a check, and it keeps going until the check passes. The model chooses every step in between. Graph: the work is split into steps that your code wires together.

questions.concept: What is the main purpose of the quiz generator built in the talk?
questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the quiz generator built in the talk?
options: To replace the model entirely
To generate a multiple-choice quiz from the slides
To act as a user interface for the model
To provide the model with more data
questions.source_quote: Our quiz generator is a harness that writes a multiple-choice quiz from these slides.
